rationale: Onboarding/billing.spec.js already covers the trial strip + landing/routing (info/warning/ended tones, paid/AWS org routing) and only lightly asserts that the Pro subscribe + Enterprise contact buttons exist. The feature under test is the pricing CARDS themselves: pricing.json-driven feature lists, price-option tiles, the Pro 'Subscribed' tag vs 'Subscribe', the Enterprise 'On discount' tag + price block, the pricing-error + Retry path, managed-billing provider messages (AWS/Azure/contract), the AI-credits card, and the child-org managed-billing panel. None of these are covered by the Onboarding spec, and the feature doc's reachability table itself marks only the trial strip as 'already covered by Onboarding/billing.spec.js'. The run-context places this in the Management area with spec_path Management/billingPlansPricing.spec.js, so a brand-new Management spec is the correct home (one spec = one feature area).
